title: docs(agents): an authored `events` bag is refused by `objectui validate` once PR objectui#11069 lands (objectui#5250)
body:
Part of #5250
Merge order: this PR merges together with or after PR objectui#11069 (slice A of objectui#5250), never before it. Until slice A lands, the sentence it replaces is still true.
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One sentence in each of two governed files, both about an authored `events` bag:

- `AGENTS.md`, section 5, commandment #4 (the action system): 「…so one that arrives as data is kept, judged by nothing and run by nothing.」
- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, the paragraph that begins 「DO NOT author an `events` bag」: the same sentence.

Both now say what is true once PR objectui#11069 lands. A typed literal refuses the bag. One that arrives as data is refused by name as an undeclared key by `objectui validate`, and named the same way by `objectui check`; both judge through the strict authoring face (objectui#5250). The tolerant zod face is `.passthrough()`: it still keeps the bag, and nothing runs it.

Nothing else changes. `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` says only 「kept and run by nothing」 about the tolerant face. That stays true, so it is not touched.

## Why

PR objectui#11069 moves `objectui validate` and `objectui check` onto `StrictAnyComponentSchema`. Probed on that PR's merged head: a `text` node and a `button` node, each carrying an `events` bag, are refused by the strict face with one `unrecognized_keys` naming `events`, and accepted by the tolerant `safeValidateSchema`. After that PR lands, 「judged by nothing」 would be false in the instruction file every agent reads first, and in the published skill.

## Gates

Head `91845ce7c`, base `main` `3c3115e38`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test AGENTS.md skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`: exit 3, `GOVERNED — 2 of 2 path(s) are on a governed surface` (`AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`). This PR stays draft and lands only after an APPROVED review by an authorized approver.
- `check:skills-paths` exit 0 (`skills/ — 29/29 resolve`); `check:skill-eval-tokens` exit 0; `check:control-bytes` exit 0; `check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`); `docs:check-links` exit 0; `check-changeset-presence` exit 0 (no released source changed, so no changeset is owed).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:skill-examples` exited 2, `PRECONDITION NOT MET` (it needs 12 packages built). The edited paragraph carries no code example. Declared to CI.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:两份写给 AI 的规程里各改一句话:仓库根的 `AGENTS.md`,和对外发布的技能包 `skills/objectui`。原句说作者写进元数据的 `events` 事件包「没有任何东西检查」。现在改成 PR objectui#11069 合并之后的事实:`objectui validate` 会按名字拒绝它,`objectui check` 也会点名它。

**为什么改**:PR objectui#11069 让命令行校验改用严格模式,`events` 这种没有渲染器读取的键会被直接拒绝。规程里如果还留着「没人检查」,AI 会以为写了也无害,或者不把校验报错当回事。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改两句文字,不动代码,也不发版。唯一的风险是合并顺序:如果先于 PR objectui#11069 合并,这两句话会提前变成假话,所以必须和它一起合并,或在它之后合并。回滚就是撤销本 PR,只涉及两处文字。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:在 PR objectui#11069 合并的同时或之后,审阅这两句话并批准本 PR。
